wolf_shadowfang.name: Shadowfang
wolf_shadowfang.description: A massive black wolf with intelligent amber eyes and a loyal heart.

special_abilities.name: Pack Hunter
special_abilities.description: Increases party damage by 15% when in combat

special_abilities.name: Night Vision
special_abilities.description: Can see perfectly in darkness, reduces danger in dark areas

special_abilities.name: Tracking
special_abilities.description: Can track creatures and find hidden paths

wolf_shadowfang.personality: Fierce but loyal. Will protect the player with their life.
dialogue: *growls protectively*
*sniffs the air and looks alert*
*nuzzles your hand affectionately*
*howls at the moon*
wolf_shadowfang.backstory: Shadowfang was once the alpha of a wolf pack until hunters killed most of their family. Now alone, they seek a new pack to protect.

fairy_lumina.name: Lumina
fairy_lumina.description: A tiny glowing fairy with gossamer wings and a mischievous smile.

special_abilities.name: Healing Light
special_abilities.description: Automatically heals party members for 10 HP per turn

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.description: Provides light in dark areas without needing a torch

special_abilities.name: Fairy Dust
special_abilities.description: Can put weak enemies to sleep

special_abilities.name: Nature's Blessing
special_abilities.description: Increases luck for finding rare items

fairy_lumina.personality: Playful and curious, but fiercely protective of nature and friends.
dialogue: Ooh, what's that? Let me see!
The trees are whispering about danger ahead...
I can make things sparkle! Watch this!
Stay close, I'll keep you safe with my magic!
These woods are my home. I know all their secrets!
fairy_lumina.backstory: Lumina is one of the last remaining forest fairies. Most of her kind have fled or faded as the darkness spreads through the woods. She joins you hoping to restore balance to her home.

golem_granite.name: Granite
golem_granite.description: A towering construct of ancient stone, animated by forgotten magic.

special_abilities.name: Stone Skin
special_abilities.description: Takes 50% less damage from physical attacks

special_abilities.name: Earthquake Stomp
special_abilities.description: Powerful AoE attack that hits all enemies

special_abilities.name: Guardian
special_abilities.description: Can take hits intended for the player

special_abilities.name: Immovable
special_abilities.description: Cannot be knocked back or stunned

golem_granite.personality: Silent and stoic. Communicates through gestures and rumbling sounds.
dialogue: *rumbles deeply*
*places a protective stone hand on your shoulder*
*pounds fist against chest in salute*
*grinding stone sounds*
golem_granite.backstory: Granite was built centuries ago to guard ancient ruins. After being reactivated, it bonds with the player and becomes their steadfast protector.

rogue_lyra.name: Lyra Swift
rogue_lyra.description: A skilled rogue with quick reflexes and a mysterious past.

special_abilities.name: Backstab
special_abilities.description: Critical hit chance increased by 40%

special_abilities.name: Lockpicking Expert
special_abilities.description: Can open any lock, no lockpicks needed

special_abilities.name: Shadow Step
special_abilities.description: Can escape any non-boss combat encounter

special_abilities.name: Treasure Hunter
special_abilities.description: Finds extra gold in chests and enemies

rogue_lyra.personality: Witty and sarcastic, but deeply loyal to those who earn her trust.
dialogue: I could pick that lock in my sleep. Watch and learn.
Trust me, I've gotten out of worse situations than this.
You've got decent instincts. For an amateur.
The guild would kill me if they knew I was helping you. Let's keep this between us.
I've got your back. Just don't expect me to play by the rules.
rogue_lyra.backstory: Lyra was betrayed by her thieves' guild and left for dead. She's looking for redemption and revenge. Her skills are invaluable, but her trust must be earned.

knight_marcus.name: Sir Marcus Lightbringer
knight_marcus.description: A noble paladin knight seeking to cleanse the woods of evil.

special_abilities.name: Divine Strike
special_abilities.description: Deals extra damage to undead and demonic enemies

special_abilities.name: Shield of Faith
special_abilities.description: Reduces damage taken by entire party by 20%

special_abilities.name: Lay on Hands
special_abilities.description: Can heal party members once per battle

special_abilities.name: Fearless
special_abilities.description: Immune to fear and intimidation effects

knight_marcus.personality: Honorable and righteous, but can be inflexible about rules and morality.
dialogue: Evil shall not prevail while I still draw breath!
Your actions speak of honor. I am proud to fight beside you.
The darkness grows stronger, but so does our resolve.
We must help those in need. It is our sacred duty.
Sometimes the hardest battles are fought within our own hearts.
knight_marcus.backstory: Marcus is the last knight of a fallen order. He's sworn to destroy the evil that corrupted his kingdom, believing its source lies in the Whispering Woods.

mage_theron.name: Theron the Arcane
mage_theron.description: An elderly wizard with vast magical knowledge and mysterious motives.

special_abilities.name: Fireball
special_abilities.description: Powerful AoE magic attack

special_abilities.name: Arcane Shield
special_abilities.description: Creates a magical barrier that absorbs damage

special_abilities.name: Identify
special_abilities.description: Can reveal the properties of magical items

special_abilities.name: Teleport
special_abilities.description: Can teleport party to previously visited locations

mage_theron.personality: Wise and cryptic, often speaks in riddles. Hides dark secrets.
dialogue: The arcane flows through all things. You need only learn to see it.
I have studied magic for seventy years. Still, there is so much I don't understand.
This forest... it's more magical than anywhere I've ever been.
Be careful what you wish for. Magic always has a price.
I sense great power within you. Untapped, but powerful nonetheless.
mage_theron.backstory: Theron came to the woods seeking forbidden knowledge. He's found something that both terrifies and fascinates him. His true intentions remain unclear.

ranger_aria.name: Aria Windwhisper
ranger_aria.description: An elven ranger who moves through the forest like a ghost.

special_abilities.name: Sure Shot
special_abilities.description: Ranged attacks never miss

special_abilities.name: Nature's Path
special_abilities.description: Party moves faster through forest terrain

special_abilities.name: Animal Friend
special_abilities.description: Can communicate with and calm wild animals

special_abilities.name: Camouflage
special_abilities.description: Party is harder to detect, avoiding some encounters

ranger_aria.personality: Calm and graceful, deeply connected to nature. Distrusts outsiders initially.
dialogue: The forest sings to me. Can you hear it?
You walk heavily. Let me teach you to move like the wind.
My people have protected these woods for millennia. Now, I protect them alone.
The trees remember everything. They tell me stories of ages past.
In time, you may learn to see the world as we elves do.
ranger_aria.backstory: Aria is one of the last wood elves in the Whispering Woods. Her people have mostly left, but she remains as guardian of the sacred groves.

brawler_grog.name: Grog Ironjaw
brawler_grog.description: A boisterous dwarf who prefers fists to weapons and ale to water.

special_abilities.name: Berserk
special_abilities.description: Damage increases as health decreases

special_abilities.name: Iron Stomach
special_abilities.description: Immune to poison and disease

special_abilities.name: Mining Expertise
special_abilities.description: Finds rare ores and gems when mining

special_abilities.name: Dwarven Resilience
special_abilities.description: Regenerates health slowly during combat

brawler_grog.personality: Loud, jovial, and always ready for a fight or a drink. Fiercely loyal.
dialogue: Ha! That's barely a scratch! Come on, hit me harder!
I once drank seventeen pints and fought a bear. Good times!
These woods are alright, but I miss the mountains.
You're not bad for a surfacer! Maybe I'll teach you to fight proper!
Ale, gold, and a good brawl - that's all a dwarf needs!
brawler_grog.backstory: Grog left his mountain clan to seek adventure and fortune. He's found both in the Whispering Woods, along with more trouble than even he bargained for.

necromancer_salem.name: Salem Darkwhisper
necromancer_salem.description: A mysterious necromancer shrouded in dark robes, commanding the undead.

special_abilities.name: Raise Undead
special_abilities.description: Summons skeleton warriors to fight for the party

special_abilities.name: Life Drain
special_abilities.description: Steals health from enemies and gives to party

special_abilities.name: Death's Touch
special_abilities.description: Instantly kills weak enemies

special_abilities.name: Speak with Dead
special_abilities.description: Can gather information from corpses and spirits

necromancer_salem.personality: Cold and calculating, but not necessarily evil. Views death as a tool.
dialogue: Death is not the end. It's merely a transformation.
The dead have much to teach us, if we're willing to listen.
Your fear of necromancy is irrational. It's just another school of magic.
I can sense the life force of everything around us. Fascinating.
Some call me evil. I call myself practical.
necromancer_salem.backstory: Salem was once a healer who turned to necromancy after failing to save their loved ones. Now they seek to master death itself, regardless of the moral cost.

assassin_shadow.name: Shadow
assassin_shadow.description: A figure wrapped in darkness, identity unknown, speaking only in whispers.

special_abilities.name: Assassinate
special_abilities.description: Guaranteed critical hit on first strike of combat

special_abilities.name: Vanish
special_abilities.description: Becomes invisible, avoiding all attacks for one turn

special_abilities.name: Shadow Walk
special_abilities.description: Can move through walls and locked doors

special_abilities.name: Death Mark
special_abilities.description: Marks an enemy for death, dealing massive damage over time

assassin_shadow.personality: Silent and enigmatic. Communicates through actions more than words.
dialogue: *gestures to move forward*
*whispers* Death comes for all...
*nods silently*
*disappears into shadows*
assassin_shadow.backstory: No one knows who or what Shadow truly is. They appeared from the darkness and offered their services. Their true motives remain a mystery.
